identity.description: An attacker executes a malicious AppleScript via osascript, which loads a dynamic library into a process. Cortex detects this behavior as a potential indicator of malicious activity. The attack involves loading a dynamic library via osascript to execute malicious code.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: AppleScript Interpreter Dynamic Library Loaded
biocs.description: Detection of dynamic library loading into osascript process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dylib'

abiocs.name: AppleScript Dynamic Library Loading Behavior
abiocs.description: Detects when osascript loads a dynamic library, indicating potential code injection or malicious AppleScript execution
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dylib'
abiocs.causality_anchor: osascript process start with dynamic library load

xql_queries.name: Detect AppleScript Dynamic Library Load
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains '.dylib'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
